description: E191. `reasons`: why a figure was not attached, was not served or could not be withdrawn, one closed key each, one sentence each, no codes; nothing was stored. `{bound}` is the only placeholder: the bound that applied, as a person reads it (the deployment's, or the smaller one of an add sent through an assistant's connection). A version the reader may not read, an unknown version and an unknown figure are refused exactly as the version itself is, never with a sentence of their own.

reasons.not-a-figure: This file is not a PNG, JPEG or PDF image or document, so it was not attached.
reasons.two-types: This file can also be read as a web page, so it was not attached.
reasons.active-content: This PDF carries scripts, launch actions or embedded files, so it was not attached.
reasons.damaged: This file says it is a PNG, JPEG or PDF but its structure cannot be read, so it was not attached.
reasons.empty: This file is empty, so it was not attached.
reasons.too-large: This file is larger than this deployment attaches ({bound}), so it was not attached.
reasons.cannot-add: You can read this version but not add a figure to it.
reasons.withdrawn: This figure was withdrawn; its reason stays with the version.
reasons.unavailable: Figures are not attached on this deployment yet.
